name: POKEMON FOLLOWERS
description: Your lead Pokemon hovers behind you in the overworld, for all 151 species. Gen 1 has no walking overworld art for Pokemon -- the ROM has 73 character sheets and, in Yellow only, SPRITE_PIKACHU -- so followers hover instead, which needs one 16x16 frame rather than six frames across four directions. That single change is what makes every species possible: the art is generated on first boot by shrinking the front battle sprites the game already extracted from your own cartridge dump, coloured with the game's own per-species palettes. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is redistributed. The follower draws but never blocks, using the engine's own passable-NPC pattern from Yellow's Pikachu. Also publishes its sprite lookup to other mods, which is how COUCH MULTIPLAYER puts a Pokemon behind other players.
